title: Run DFT total energy calculations for fct Fe NM, AF, FM phases
action: Use an all-electron DFT code (e.g., Elk, FLEUR, WIEN2k) to perform spin‑polarized total‑energy calculations for face‑centered tetragonal (fct) Fe with in‑plane lattice constants a = b = 3.84 Å. For each of the three magnetic configurations — nonmagnetic (NM), antiferromagnetic (AF), and ferromagnetic (FM) — optimize the out‑of‑plane lattice constant c (or scan c/a ratio) to find the total‑energy minimum. Use a sufficiently dense k‑point mesh and convergence criteria.
description: This step executes the DFT calculations. The agent must record evidence of execution (e.g., a log file). The computed total energies are carried forward to the next step.

title: Extract and report total energy differences
action: From the DFT output of step_dft_scan, extract the total energy per atom (in mRy) for the equilibrium geometry of each magnetic phase. Set the FM energy as the reference (0.000 mRy/atom) and compute the energy differences E_AF – E_FM and E_NM – E_FM. Write a JSON file with the per‑phase energies and the differences.
description: Report the minimum total energies per atom for FM, AF, and NM phases and the relative energy differences. The FM energy is set as the zero reference.
output_schema: JSON object with keys: 'FM' (object with 'energy_per_atom_mRy' (float)), 'AF' (object with 'energy_per_atom_mRy' (float)), 'NM' (object with 'energy_per_atom_mRy' (float)), and 'energy_differences' (object with 'AF_minus_FM_mRy' (float) and 'NM_minus_FM_mRy' (float)). All values in mRy/atom.
